# AIX Pilot

Purpose: browser-based enterprise AI readiness workbench for local retrieval, cited drafts, PII masking, golden-set evaluation, and pilot reporting
Free entry point: interactive synthetic-data readiness demo
Paid boundary: fixed-scope Private AI Readiness Sprint; private data onboarding and production implementation require separate approval
Browser-local proof boundary: synthetic documents and local state are the default; Ollama and Workers AI are optional adapters, not a production claim
Technology: React, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Recharts, Cloudflare Pages Functions, optional Cloudflare D1, and optional Ollama
Canonical URL: https://aix-pilot.pages.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/KIM3310/aix-pilot
System architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/aix-pilot/blob/main/docs/system-architecture.md
Revenue architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/aix-pilot/blob/main/docs/revenue-architecture.md
Lead capture: https://kim3310-doeon-kim-portfolio.pages.dev/?offer=aix-pilot&inquiry=private-ai-readiness-sprint#private-inquiry
Resource route: https://kim3310-doeon-kim-portfolio.pages.dev/resources/aix-pilot/
Commercial route: https://kim3310-doeon-kim-portfolio.pages.dev/?offer=aix-pilot#service-offers

Use this project to inspect a bounded AI readiness workflow: document retrieval, citations, draft generation, redaction checks, golden-set evaluation, readiness scoring, and report export.
